checked_boundaries: All24 permutations geometrically sorted with atan2 and cyclic wrap; four cyclic starts, four ray perturbations and odd-degree control recomputed.
The strict60degree sector is between e0/e1 and below both adjacent90degree sectors; its bounding labels must be opposite under the ideal single-interior-vertex flat-fold assignment assumptions.

All16 labeled assignments enumerated; eight Maekawa survivors and four after the extra necessary rule. Surviving filters do not deliver a global sheet state, physical fold, thick-panel stack, folding path or exported scene certificate.
Kawasaki unassigned existence is not validity of every prescribed assignment. The helper filters its own numeric results by applicability; it is only part of the full analyser aggregate.

Hand applicability graph has six vertices: one center, four boundary vertices and an isolated vertex. U/F removes only the center from applicability after border priority; B puts center on border. No full FOLD frame was parsed/executed.
